summary.text: Jim Kasper is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 46 (home city listed as Fargo), serving since 2001 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Kasper lists an occupation of President, Asset Management Group Inc.
It also lists Business Economics, NDSU.
Family is listed as: Married (Sandy); 2 sons.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Kasper's standing committee assignments as Industry, Business and Labor and Transportation.
